dct_title_s: Myanmar tentative UNESCO World Heritage Sites
dct_description_sm: Polygon dataset of all 15 properties considered to be cultural and/or natural heritage of outstanding universal value and submitted by Myanmar for inscription on the World Heritage List. Based on documents from https://whc.unesco.org/en/tentativelists. Approximate geolocation added by CDE Myanmar based on publicly available reference data and local knowledge. Original dataset title: Myanmar tentative UNESCO World Heritage Sites (2020)
